Markup e Margem possuem diferenças?

Markup: É um índice multiplicador, baseado na ideia de preço margem, aplicado ao custo envolvido em cada produto. A principal função deste método é encontrar um preço que exceda o custo enquanto se alcança o lucro esperado. 

Markup = 100 / [100 – (DV + DF + LP)].

Margem: É a receita total de vendas da empresa. Ou seja, o valor restante após o pagamento dos custos do produto e dos impostos. O restante é usado para pagar taxas fixas e garantir lucros. Para calcular, você pode usar a seguinte fórmula:

Margem de contribuição = valor das vendas – (custos variáveis + despesas variáveis).

This might surprise you, but...

...it's perfectly OK if we haven't found your dream home yet!

The market is competitive and buyers with perfect credit, zero contingencies and very attractive offers are being turned down left and right. 

But some frustration is understandable, so if you feel like you're hitting a wall on your home search, here are some tips I give my clients:

1️⃣ Be clear on your budget and what home features are non-negotiable for you.

If you can live with a one-car garage instead of two or skip the finished basement, that might give us more options. 

2️⃣ Reevaluate your list of wants/needs. Is there something you can adjust?

If you're planning to use that fourth bedroom as a home office, maybe a three bedroom with a bonus room would fit the bill. 

3️⃣ Consider expanding the geographic parameters on your search.

Even expanding your search radius by a few blocks can open up more inventory and options you might not have seen otherwise. 

4️⃣ Be patient. This is a challenging market but your home is out there! 

Drop me a message if you have questions about home buying in this current market.

On International Women's Day, what better way to celebrate than with homeownership? 🤩

Single women are a growing force in the housing market. Although millennials are buying fewer houses than previous generations, millennial women seem to be outpacing men when it comes to buying homes.

According to the National Association of Realtors, single women made up 19 percent of all homebuyers in 2021. 

A separate survey by Bank of America found a similar ""house-before-spouse trend"" a they reported that 65 percent of single female prospective homebuyers said they’d rather not wait for marriage to buy a home, and 30 percent of women who already own homes bought them when they were single. 

Whether you're single or coupled, here are a few ways to get on track to buy a home this year: 

👉🏼 Get your financial house in order: pay down debt and establish a savings account. 
👉🏼 Raise your credit score so that you'll qualify for a lower mortgage rate.
👉🏼 Research first-time buyer programs to see what type of loan you're eligible to borrow.
👉🏼 Factor emergency maintenance costs into your savings.
👉🏼 Be prepared for a competitive market. Demand is high and inventory is low, so patience is key this year. 

​Now, a question for you: would you buy a home without a partner? If you're a homeowner, were you single when you bought your first home?

* I’m 33 and not ashamed to admit that I still don’t have my life completely figured out.
* I’m scared of losing the people I love.
* I’ve stayed in situations longer than I should have because I kept hoping things would change.
* I don’t always know how to balance being a mother, a daughter, a wife and still being me.
* I’ve made financial mistakes, and I’m still learning how to handle money better.
* I’ve worked hard and still had phases where I felt like I was going nowhere.
* Sometimes I’m surrounded by people and still feel lonely.
* There are days when I don’t want to be strong for everybody.
* I’ve outgrown people I genuinely thought would be in my life forever.
* I’ve struggled with my body and allowed a number on the scale to affect how I saw myself.
* I still need my mother. And I don’t think there’ll ever be an age when I won’t.
* Motherhood hasn’t made me stop wanting things for myself.
* I’ve had to start over more than once.
* I don’t forgive as easily as I used to.
* Some things that happened to me changed me permanently.
* I’m learning that loving someone doesn’t automatically make a relationship easy.
* I’ve realised that being busy and being fulfilled are two completely different things.
* I’m still learning to say no without feeling guilty.
* I don’t want a huge circle anymore. I want a safe one.
* And at 33, I’m not trying to become the person everyone expects me to be. I’m trying to become someone I can live peacefully with.

Social Day in Lengerich, Tecklenburg & Ladbergen 🧡 

Zum 8. Mal in Lengerich, zum 5. Mal in Tecklenburg und zum 3. Mal in Ladbergen hieß es wieder: raus aus dem Ausbildungsalltag und rein ins soziale Engagement! 

Den Social Day haben @bischofundklein_karriere, @wh_ausbildung und @dyckerhoff_life bereits 2016 ins Leben gerufen. Seitdem stellen Unternehmen ihre Azubis für einen Tag frei, damit sie sich in sozialen Projekten und Einrichtungen engagieren können. 

Dieses Jahr waren 8 Unternehmen mit insgesamt 55 Azubis dabei. Nach der Begrüßung durch Bürgermeister Schilling der @stadt.lengerich, Bürgermeister Torsten Buller von Ladbergen und Roland Droste Bischof+Klein wurden die Auszubildenden per Losverfahren auf 17 soziale Einrichtungen verteilt. Dort packten sie tatkräftig mit an und unterstützten, wo Hilfe gebraucht wurde. 

Zum Abschluss ging es ab 13 Uhr gemeinsam ins Stadion. Bei Pizza fand der Tag einen gemütlichen Ausklang. 🍕 

Ein großes Dankeschön an alle Unternehmen, Azubis und Einrichtungen, die diesen Social Day möglich gemacht haben!

Nur wenige Wochen nach der Einweihung der weltweit ersten Forschungs- und Entwicklungsanlage zur CO₂-Abscheidung mit dem Pure-Oxyfuel-Verfahren informierte sich der baden-württembergische Ministerpräsident @cem.oezdemir vor Ort über den aktuellen Projektfortschritt.

Bei einem Rundgang durch die Anlage erhielt er Einblicke in die technologischen Grundlagen des Vorhabens, die bisherigen Betriebserfahrungen sowie die Bedeutung von Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage (CCUS) für die Dekarbonisierung der Zementindustrie. Der Besuch verdeutlicht die wichtige Rolle von Forschung, Innovation und verlässlichen politischen Rahmenbedingungen für die industrielle Transformation und den Weg zu einer zukunftsfähigen Baustoffproduktion. 🌍

Die vier europäischen Zementhersteller Buzzi / @dyckerhoff_life, @heidelbergmaterials_de, @schwenk_deutschland und Vicat haben sich 2019 zur Forschungsgesellschaft CI4C GmbH & Co. Can I find part-time work in Finland?🤔 Do I need to learn Finnish? 🤔What's the best education for me?🤔 
 
Student recruitment expert Sarianne speaks to thousands of people considering Finland as their study destination. If you're one of them, here are five things you need to know: 
 
1. Choose the right education type for your career goals and learning style. 
Universities and universities of applied science have different approaches and goals. Familiarize yourself with the different education types and pick the one that furthers your career goals and suits the way you learn. 

2. Figure out your finances. 
Finding a part-time job in Finland is not guaranteed. Especially for internationals it is very challenging, so make sure you have enough funds to get you through your studies without a job. 

3. Prepare to take ownership over your studies. 
In Finland, students are expected to manage their studies quite independently. While there is plenty of support and resources to help you with it, you need to get behind the wheel and be proactive about planning your life. 

4. Learn Finnish. 
While English is the official campus language at many universities, learning Finnish will improve your employment chances, help you integrate and find your place in the community. 

5. Have a plan B. 
Studying abroad is a huge step, and things don't always go as planned in life and your studies. With alternative plans, and thinking through different options, it will be easier to adapt to changing situations.
